story.inspiration: Ocean water quality sensing is important to identify the impact of human activities on the aquatic environment and ecosystem. It directly impacts our health and economy. An algal bloom, caused by excess nutrients pollution in water, is harmful to aquatic life.

sensingUnit.title: Ocean Water Quality Sensing Unit
sensingUnit.description: Here, we developed a hardware system for ocean water quality sensing. Users can view different parameters of water quality such as Air temperature, Air humidity, Water temperature, pH, Turbidity, GPS (location), TDS (total dissolved solids), Water level.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Users select points on the map to view parameters including pH, TDS, water temperature, air temperature, humidity, water level, dissolve O2 level.

howWeBuiltIt.frontend: Front-end development using html, css, javascript, apex charts and d3.js
howWeBuiltIt.hardware: Hardware development using C++ and ESP32

internationalTeam.title: International Team and Timezones
internationalTeam.description: We are an international team with 4 timezones, not all developers are awake at the same time. We overcame this by effective planning and communication.

datasetAccess.title: Satellite Images Dataset Access
datasetAccess.description: We had trouble accessing the satellite images dataset to identify harmful algae bloom. By the time he had access to it, it was too late to implement it.

corsPolicy.title: CORS Policy
corsPolicy.description: Finding workarounds to 'Blocked by CORS policy'

story.whatWeLearned: We learned a lot about hardware development. It was our first time using D3.js.
story.whatIsNext: Implement Harmful algae bloom detection using satellite images
